title: Yocan Kodo Pro 510 Battery
description:
The Kodo Pro features an OLED display with a puff counter, pre-heating functionality, a built-in safety cut-off, and precision voltage adjustment. The adjustable voltage ranges from 1.8V to 4.2V with easy-to-use left (-) and right (+) buttons to dial in the desired voltage setting. Compact, portable, and compatible with a standard Type-C USB charger, the Kodo Pro is perfect for on-the-go.

Product Features:
– 510 thread
– Puff counter
– Pre-heating functionality
– Built-in safety cut-off
– Precision voltage adjustment
– Type-C USB charging

What’s Included:
1 x Kodo Pro 510 Battery

Purposefully cable-free. Most clients have a USB-C cable already. No clutter, no waste.
If you need one — we’ve got options.
